abort.already_configured: The integration already has an entry for this group of this provider, or for this E-Svitlo account.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry now uses the new group. To update the entity IDs, open the device and select Recreate entity IDs.
abort.reconfigure_unchanged: The entry already uses this group. Nothing changed.
abort.reconfigure_e_svitlo: E-Svitlo takes the group from your account. To select another account, delete this integration entry and add it again.
abort.e_svitlo_connection_error:
Failed to get the accounts from E-Svitlo.
The E-Svitlo server is unreachable, or it answered with an error.
Make sure that Home Assistant can connect to the Internet, and try again later.
abort.yasno_connection_error:
Failed to get the Yasno groups.
The Yasno API is unreachable, or it has no groups for this provider now.
Make sure that Home Assistant can connect to the Internet, and try again later.
{url}
abort.dtek_json_unavailable:
No data source gave a schedule that the integration can read.
The source is unreachable, or its data has a format that the integration does not know.
Make sure that Home Assistant can connect to the Internet, and try again later.
{urls}
abort.dtek_json_empty_data:
The data source answered, but its schedule has no groups now.
This can happen when the provider publishes no outages.
Try again later.
{urls}
abort.reauth_successful: The entry now uses the new login.
abort.wrong_account: This login has no access to the personal account of this entry. Sign in with the login that owns this personal account.

data_description.provider: The region or the distribution system operator that supplies electricity to your address.

data_description.username: Use login and password from E-Svitlo personal cabinet: {esvitlo_url}
data_description.password: The password of your E-Svitlo personal cabinet.

data_description.account_id: The personal account (address) whose outage schedule the integration shows. For another address, add one more integration entry.

stale_confirm.title: Outdated schedule data
stale_confirm.description:
No fresh outage data is available right now. The source last updated the schedule on {updated}.

You can pick a group from this outdated schedule, but once outages resume please double-check that your group assignment has not changed.

data.acknowledge: I understand and accept the risk

data_description.acknowledge: To continue with the outdated schedule, select this checkbox.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to E-Svitlo again
reauth_confirm.description: E-Svitlo refused the login of this entry. Enter the current login and password of your E-Svitlo personal cabinet. Until then, the entities show the last schedule. If E-Svitlo has maintenance now, you can also wait: the integration tries the old login at each update.

data_description.username: The login of your E-Svitlo personal cabinet: {esvitlo_url}
data_description.password: The current password of your E-Svitlo personal cabinet.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to E-Svitlo. Make sure that Home Assistant can connect to the Internet, and try again.
error.acknowledge_required: The checkbox is not selected. To continue with the outdated schedule, select it.

group_not_listed.title: No outage schedule for group {group}
group_not_listed.description:
The source {provider} has no outage schedule for group {group}. Until the source has it, the Electricity sensor shows Unknown, and the calendars show no outages for this group.

The provider can renumber or remove groups. Find your group on the website of the provider. To change the group, go to Settings > Devices & services > {integration}, open the menu of this entry, and select Reconfigure.

This message disappears when the source has group {group} again.

refresh_failed.message: Failed to get a new outage schedule, because the source did not answer. The entities keep the last schedule. Make sure that Home Assistant can connect to the Internet, and try again later.

login_rejected.message: E-Svitlo refused the login. To enter the current password, go to Settings > Devices & services. If E-Svitlo has maintenance now, try again later.

unknown_provider_type.message: This entry has the unknown provider type «{provider_type}». Delete the entry and add it again.

unknown_dtek_provider.message: This version of the integration has no DTEK source «{provider}». Delete the entry and add it again with the region of your address.

entry_without_region.message: This entry has no region. Delete the entry and add it again.

entry_without_provider.message: This entry has no provider. Delete the entry and add it again.

entry_without_group.message: This entry has no group. Delete the entry and add it again.

entry_without_login.message: This E-Svitlo entry has no login or password. Delete the entry and add it again.
